title: E2E: post article, verify sig+DKIM, check NNTP and JMAP surfaces
description:
End-to-end test covering the full verification pipeline from ingest to surface exposure.

What: crates/integration-tests/tests/verification_e2e.rs

Test 1 — sig_pass_visible_in_nntp:
1. Start in-process reader with verify_store and a known ed25519 signing key.
2. POST a valid article with correct X-Usenet-IPFS-Sig header (signed with the known key).
3. ARTICLE command on the posted message.
4. Assert: response contains 'X-Usenet-IPFS-Verified: usenet-ipfs-sig=pass'.
5. Assert: article_verifications row in SQLite has result='pass'.
6. Assert: seen_keys row present with correct key_id.

Test 2 — sig_fail_visible_in_nntp:
1. Same setup, but tamper article body after signing (flip one byte).
2. Assert: X-Usenet-IPFS-Verified: usenet-ipfs-sig=fail in ARTICLE response.
3. Assert: article was still accepted (250 OK on POST) — verification failure does not reject.

Test 3 — no_sig_no_header:
1. POST article with no X-Usenet-IPFS-Sig header.
2. ARTICLE response: X-Usenet-IPFS-Verified header absent entirely.

Test 4 — jmap_verifications_property:
1. POST signed article via NNTP.
2. Fetch via JMAP Email/get.
3. Assert: x-usenet-ipfs-verifications contains entry with type='usenet-ipfs-sig' result='pass'.

DKIM tests are unit-level (W2); E2E DKIM requires live DNS which is not available in CI.
DKIM E2E: one additional test using a local mock resolver injected into the pipeline — pre-seeded with a TXT record; POST article with a matching DKIM-Signature; assert dkim=pass in NNTP header.
